en.title: Its Distant Cousin Is an Elephant. Can You Name It?
en.description: This is the rock hyrax. It weighs only about 4 kg, yet its long tusk-like upper incisors recall the elephant, to which it is distantly related. Groups use sentries to sound the alarm, and the animals can go many days without water.
